create_Beta_distribution: create a Beta distribution with concentration1 and concentration0 parameters using torch.distributions.Beta
sample_Beta_distribution: sample from a Beta distribution using the rsample method with a given sample shape
compute_Beta_mean: compute the mean of a Beta distribution as concentration1 divided by the sum of both concentrations
compute_Beta_variance: compute the variance of a Beta distribution using concentration1, concentration0, and their sum
compute_Beta_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Beta distribution using the log_prob method
